name: AI Platform
description: Run AI models on your own GPU: chat, agent mode, images, video and voice, with an OpenAI-compatible API the other apps use.

variants.name: With built-in Ollama
variants.description: Runs models on this machine's NVIDIA GPU (or CPU). Recommended.

variants.name: Slim
variants.description: No built-in model engine; point it at an Ollama server elsewhere.

settings.name: AMY_HF_TOKEN
settings.label: Hugging Face token
settings.description: For gated image and video models. Can also be added later in the AI Platform's Settings.

settings.name: AMY_OLLAMA_URL
settings.label: Ollama server URL
settings.description: Slim only: an Ollama server to use, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. Leave blank with the built-in Ollama.

settings.name: AMY_GITHUB_TOKEN
settings.label: GitHub token for agent mode
settings.description: Lets agent mode clone private repos and push. A fine-grained token limited to those repos is best.
